text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hit. Give me another card.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! Another card!? Ever heard of 
overplaying your hand? That definitely 
busts '21'."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the concern. Why don't you 
spend the rest of your life playing it 
nice and safe, you bastard?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on. I was just thinking it's 
about time I taught you a harsh lesson 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I'll make that cheeky face of yours 
swell up with tears.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey?! This is seriously bad, isn't 
it?! Shouldn't we go get a teacher or 
someone...?!

When I visited the cafeteria, there seemed 
to be some sort of commotion going on.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? T-Trainer!? Please come over here for 
a second! We have a problem...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Those two are out of control! Their 
matchup is getting way too heated..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Right now, we are fighting with 
"expulsion" on the line!

This is really bad! I have to step in and 
stop them...!
choice_data_list:
Calm down, both of you! Let's stop this 
match!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't throw cold water on this. Things are 
at their absolute hottest right now. Don't 
get in my way.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. Let's continue the game, Nakayama. 
Time to switch dealers.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"I'm looking forward to watching you burst 
into flames in spectacular fashion."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What a cheeky brat at every turn. I'll 
settle things right here.

Both of them are way too heated up and 
refuse to listen to a word I say!

However, I can't just stand by and watch. 
I have to stop this, no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama & Sirius
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list:
If I win, you'll have to retract the 
expulsion!

If I win, you're going to revoke that 
expulsion!

text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha...! You're a complete wreck! 
Where'd all that bravado from earlier go, 
huh?!

The losses keep piling up without a single 
highlight. These two are way too 
strong...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You should call it quits soon, Trainer. 
Your losses are only going to pile up, you 
know?
Still, I can't back down now.

The game is blackjack. It's a game where 
you build a hand whose card values get as 
close to 21 as possible.

Right now, my hand totals '16'. It feels a 
bit weak, but if I draw another card, I 
might bust over 21.

I can't afford to lose here. Do I draw 
another card, or do I stay...?
choice_data_list:
Stand. I have no choice but to stop 
drawing cards.

text_block_list.text:
"The card dealt was a '10'. It went over 
21."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha...! They blew themselves up in 
spectacular fashion...! Not that I hate 
that kind of thing, though!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Looks like we win.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Hahahaha...! Look how pathetic you 
are! Ahahahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "Mine's '21'. Blackjack."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Me too.

"16" against "21". In a match I couldn't 
afford to lose, I suffered defeat...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Hahahaha...! Look how pathetic you 
are! Ahahahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Tch... I'll let you off the hook for 
today, in honor of your pathetic loss.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: It means the mood was ruined.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, watching you lose so miserably 
was more than enough entertainment for 
today.
choice_data_list: ...Save that fiery spirit for the race.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'll think about it.
